transfer_to_number.name: transfer_to_number
transfer_to_number.description: Transfer only a clearly safe green call when the caller explicitly requests a person. Never transfer amber calls that remain unverified and never transfer any call involving payment or refund changes, account access, remote-access software, passwords, MFA or verification codes, private records, or other social-engineering signals.

transfers.condition: The caller has an ordinary low-risk request, explicitly asks to speak with a person, and has not requested or mentioned payment changes, refunds, account access, remote-access software, passwords, MFA or verification codes, customer records, staff availability, or other sensitive information.
